name: cpu_index_tuple_cost
description: Sets the planner's estimate of the CPU cost to process each index tuple during an index scan.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans choosing sequential scans over index scans
Poor index usage despite selective predicates
Increased query execution time for indexed lookups
tuning_tips: Lower this value if index scans are underutilized despite good selectivity; raise slightly only if index scans consistently perform worse than sequential scans on your hardware. Always keep it less than cpu_tuple_cost.
